abstract: >
  [ABSTRACT TO BE WRITTEN AFTER RESULTS] We study whether port digitalization
  reduces vessel delays and trade costs, exploiting the staggered rollout of
  Brazil's maritime single window (Porto Sem Papel) across public ports
  between 2011 and 2013. We combine ANTAQ berthing microdata, Comex Stat
  trade flows and a curated registry of digital interventions integrated in a
  purpose-built information system, the Brazilian Port Digital Transformation
  Observatory. [RESULT TO BE GENERATED]
keywords: [port digitalization, maritime single window, trade costs, difference-in-differences, stochastic frontier, information systems]
